This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |

| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |

```bash
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. ## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │

                                               │

                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

16	### 2.1 张量并行(Tensor Parallelism,TP)是什么
17	
18	一个 Transformer 的权重是大矩阵。单卡放不下、或想加快前向时,可以把矩阵切开分给多张卡,每张卡算自己那一块,再用集合通信(all-reduce / all-gather)把结果拼回来。这就是 Megatron-LM 风格的张量并行:

21	- **列切分(column shard)**:把输入维度切开。例如 `o_proj` 的输入是注意力头拼接后的维度,头被切走了,输入列也要跟着切。

24	
25	- **rank**:本进程在 TP 组里的编号,从 0 开始。
26	- **world_size**:TP 组的卡数,记作 \( W \)。
27	- **shard(分片)**:某个全局维度中本 rank 持有的 `(offset, len)` 切片。

30

151	### 4.2 shard 切分公式:LocalGeometry 从已验证的 Config35 派生本 rank 维度
152	
153	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
154	
155	`LocalGeometry` 回答的问题是:"在 `W` 卡 TP 下,**本 rank** 的全注意力头数、KV 头数、MLP 中间宽度、线性注意力头数……各是多少?" 它是 `Qwen35Model` 加载一切缓冲、切一切权重所依据的几何底座。
156	
157	它的输入是两个**已经各自合法**的类型:`&Config35`(模型几何,上一讲)和 `TensorParallelConfig`(TP 指派,本讲 4.1)。它的工作分两段:
158	
159	1. **兼容性校验**:不是所有合法模型都能配所有 `world_size`——切不开就得拒。
160	2. **维度派生**:对切得开的模型,算出本 rank 的全部 `local_*` 字段。
161	
162	方向性边界在模块文档里写得非常清楚:[src/config/tp.rs:L1-L11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L1-L11) 说明本模块**依赖** `model`(读已验证的 `Config35` 来派生分片维度),而 `model` 对 TP 一无所知、**从不反向依赖**本模块;下游代码接受这里产出的 `LocalGeometry` 类型,而不是拿着裸 `(rank, world_size)` 自己重算分片。`src/config/mod.rs` 的模块文档([L1-L9](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/mod.rs#L1-L9))把这套所有权模型总结为三条边界。
163	
164	一句话:**`Config35` 描述"模型是什么",`TensorParallelConfig` 描述"我是谁",`LocalGeometry` 描述"我分到什么"。**
165	
166	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
167	
168	`LocalGeometry::try_new(config, tp)` 先做**四条有序整除检查**(首错即返,错误都是 `TpIndivisible`):
169	
170	```text
171	num_attention_heads  % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "num_attention_heads", ... }
172	num_key_value_heads  % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "num_key_value_heads", ... }
173	intermediate_size    % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "intermediate_size", ... }
174	linear_num_key_heads % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "linear_num_key_heads", ... }
175	```
176	
177	为什么 `linear_num_value_heads` 不在清单里?靠数学传递:`Config35` 层已强制 value 头数是 key 头数的整数倍(value = key × k,见 4.2.3 引用的 `LinearHeadDivisibility` 检查),而这里又强制 key 头数是 \( W \) 的倍数(key = \( W \) × m),于是 value = \( W \) × m × k,必然被 \( W \) 整除。源码注释也点明了这一点:"the value-head count follows from the `Config35` key/value-head invariant"。
178	
179	四条检查通过后,派生公式如下(记 \( W \) = world_size,`hd` = head_dim = 256,`khd` = linear_key_head_dim = 128,`vhd` = linear_value_head_dim = 128——三个 head dim 都是 AOT 内核烘焙的常量,上一讲已讲):
180	
181	| 字段 | 公式 |
182	|---|---|
183	| `local_num_attention_heads` | \( \text{num\_attention\_heads} / W \) |
184	| `local_num_key_value_heads` | \( \text{num\_key\_value\_heads} / W \) |
185	| `local_intermediate_size` | \( \text{intermediate\_size} / W \) |
186	| `local_full_attn_q_dim` | \( \text{local\_num\_attention\_heads} \times \text{hd} \) |
187	| `local_full_attn_kv_dim` | \( \text{local\_num\_key\_value\_heads} \times \text{hd} \) |
188	| `local_full_attn_gated_q_dim` | \( 2 \times \text{local\_full\_attn\_q\_dim} \)(Q 与 gate 拼在一起) |
189	| `local_linear_num_key_heads` | \( \text{linear\_num\_key\_heads} / W \) |
190	| `local_linear_num_value_heads` | \( \text{linear\_num\_value\_heads} / W \) |
191	| `local_linear_q_dim`(内部量) | \( \text{local\_linear\_num\_key\_heads} \times \text{khd} \) |
192	| `local_linear_v_dim` | \( \text{local\_linear\_num\_value\_heads} \times \text{vhd} \) |
193	| `local_linear_qkv_dim` | \( 2 \times \text{local\_linear\_q\_dim} + \text{local\_linear\_v\_dim} \)(k 行镜像 q 行) |
194	| `local_linear_z_dim` | \( = \text{local\_linear\_v\_dim} \)(z 投影输出宽等于 v 维) |
195	
196	注意一个容易忽略的事实:**`hidden_size` 从不切分**。残差流宽度在所有 rank 上完整保留,被切的只是各投影的输出维与 MLP 中间维。`local_full_attn_q_dim` 等字段也不是逐条独立检查的产物,而是派生——检查只针对"切得开"的头数/宽度,维度跟着头数走。
197	
198	消费侧:`LocalGeometry` 是 `Clone + Copy` 的小结构,加载时存进 `Qwen35Model.geometry` 字段([src/weights.rs:L57-L87](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L57-L87)),权重切片结构 `Shard` / `WeightSource` 全部从它取范围——例如 [src/weights/layers.rs:L191-L211](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L191-L211) 的 `Shard::flat(global, geometry)` 就是 `shard_range` 的一层薄封装,把 `(offset, len)` 与切分前的全局宽度配对(防呆:range 与 global 必须成对出现,防止把 A 维度的范围配到 B 维度的全局值上)。

299	```rust
300	pub const SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES: &[usize] = &[1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8];
301	```
302	
303	CUDA Graph(第 4 单元会细讲)要求把整步解码内核**捕获**进图里重放。如果当前组比率没有编译版批量解码内核,就得改走"批量混合 eager 回退"路径——用 paged-prefill 内核按单 token 步进计划跑注意力。这条回退路径**不能被图捕获**。于是产生一个兼容性问题:
304	
305	> 用户请求了 CUDA Graph + 当前 GQA 组没有编译内核,怎么办?
306	
307	答案分两层,这就是源码注释里称为 **P2c** 的门(注释中的编号,指该兼容性条目):
308	
309	1. **谓词层**(`Config35::decode_group_is_compiled`):组比率 ∈ `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES`?这是**配置层**的纯函数,不含 TP。
310	2. **决策层**(执行器启动):`enable_cuda_graph && decode_group_is_compiled()` 才启用图;否则**降级到 eager 路径并打日志**,而不是报错拒绝启动。
311	
312	关键在于:这个门**不在 `tp.rs` 里**。`LocalGeometry::try_new` 的文档注释([src/config/tp.rs:L93-L108](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L93-L108))明确写着:"CUDA Graph under TP is gated at executor startup on `Config35::decode_group_is_compiled` (P2c): uncompiled GQA groups keep the batched eager path instead of failing validation here."——几何校验管几何,内核路由门放在启动层,职责不混。
313	
314	而这一切在 TP 下不产生"各 rank 裁决不一致"的风险,原因是 4.2 练习 1 的结论:**组比率 TP 不变**。
315	
316	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
317	
318	```text
319	启动(enable_cuda_graph, W 卡)
320	  ├─ 每个 rank: LocalGeometry::try_new 通过(几何已验证)
321	  ├─ 谓词: decode_group_is_compiled()
322	  │     = SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES.contains(num_attention_heads / num_key_value_heads)
323	  │     (组比率 TP 不变 ⇒ 所有 rank 得到同一答案)
324	  ├─ graph_enabled = enable_cuda_graph && compiled
325	  ├─ 未编译: 打一次 info 日志(Once 保证),decode 留在批量 eager 路径
326	  └─ 运行期 batch_decode:
327	        compiled  → 正常批量解码内核(可入图)
328	        未编译   → paged-prefill 内核 + 每 token 步进计划(eager),
329	                   且断言 graph_use == Serve(禁止把 eager 路径捕获进图)
330	```
331	
332	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
333	
334	谓词定义——[src/config/model.rs:L146-L152](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L146-L152):`decode_group_is_compiled` 一行核心——查 `num_attention_heads / num_key_value_heads` 是否在 `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES` 里,注释说明"未编译的 GQA 组走批量混合 eager 回退"。注意它读的是**全局**配置字段,而组比率无论全局还是本 rank 都相同。
335	
336	启动层的门——[src/tp_executor.rs:L714-L733](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/tp_executor.rs#L714-L733):加载完全部 rank 的模型后,取 rank 0 的模型算 `graph_enabled = enable_cuda_graph && first.config().decode_group_is_compiled()`。上方注释就是 P2c 条目的正文:"graph decode under TP requires a compiled batch-decode kernel for the rank-local GQA group. The group ratio is TP-invariant, so every rank decides identically; an uncompiled group keeps the batched eager path byte-for-byte."("byte-for-byte"意为回退路径的数值行为与无图时完全一致。)若请求了图但未启用,用 `std::sync::Once` 只打一次 info 日志,日志里用 `geometry.local_num_attention_heads() / geometry.local_num_key_value_heads()` 报出**本 rank 的**组比率与头数——注意这里正是 `LocalGeometry` 的 `local_*` 字段被消费的实例,且除法结果与全局组比率相同。
337	
338	运行期的路由——[src/batch_decode.rs:L344-L360](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L344-L360):每步批量解码时再次按 `self.config.decode_group_is_compiled()` 分路——未编译就构造一个"eager decode"的每 token paged 计划,把全注意力交给 paged-prefill 内核。注释重申:"Head sharding leaves the q-per-kv group size unchanged, so the config-level predicate decides the per-rank route identically on every rank; the reroute adds no collectives."(头切分不改变组比率,配置层谓词让每个 rank 路由一致,改道不增加任何集合通信。)
339	
340	eager 路径拒绝入图——[src/batch_decode.rs:L428-L443](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L428-L443):`!decode_group_is_compiled()` 时 `anyhow::ensure!(graph_use == DecodeGraphUse::Serve, ...)`——批量混合 eager 回退只支持惰性的服务态解码,任何试图对它做图捕获/重放的 `graph_use` 都直接报错。这把"eager 路径不可入图"从约定升格为断言。
341	
342	#### 4.3.4 代码实践:核对一个配置的 P2c 判定
343	
344	**实践目标**:对若干配置(真实与假想)预测 P2c 门的结果,理解"降级不拒绝"的取舍。
345	
346	**操作步骤**(纸面推导 + 源码对照):
347	
348	1. 真实形状:tp.rs 测试夹具的 Qwen3.5-4B 形状是 16 q 头 / 4 kv 头 → 组比率 4 → 查 `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES = [1,2,3,4,6,8]` → **已编译**。TP2 下本 rank 8 q 头 / 2 kv 头 → 比率仍 4 → 结论不变。
349	2. 假想形状 A:20 q 头 / 4 kv 头 → 组比率 5 → **不在清单** → 若用户开了 CUDA Graph,启动后看到的是一条 info 日志(不是错误),decode 走 eager 回退。
350	3. 假想形状 B(4.2.4 的配置):32 / 8 → 比率 4 → 已编译 → TP2 可用图。
351	4. 阅读上面的三段源码,确认:谓词在 config 层、决策在启动层、路由在每步解码层——三层各用一次同一个纯函数,没有任何一处把组比率写死。
352	
353	**需要观察的现象**:判定只依赖组比率一个数;同一配置在 W=1 与 W=2 下判定恒同。
354	
355	**预期结果**:A 类配置(比率 5)在带图请求下仍能启动并服务,只是 decode 永远走 eager;B 类配置可启用图。若运行时有人试图把 eager 路径捕获进图,会在 `batch_decode.rs` 的 `ensure!` 处得到明确错误。
356	
357	**待本地验证**:如需真实日志输出,可在具备双 GPU 与模型权重的环境运行 TP 服务(第 7 单元的 `tests/serving_tp2.rs` 相关内容);无 GPU 时以源码与上述推理为准。
358	
359	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
360	
361	**练习 1**:为什么 P2c 门放在执行器启动层,而不是并进 `LocalGeometry::try_new` 的整除检查?
362	
363	**答案**:两者性质不同。整除性是**几何**不变量——切不开就无法加载,必须 fail-closed 拒绝;组比率 × CUDA Graph 是**运行模式**兼容性——有安全的回退路径(eager),应当降级并告知,而不是拒绝服务。把可回退的检查塞进几何校验会让"能跑但要降级"的配置被误杀。`tp.rs` 的文档注释明确把这一职责让给了启动层。
364	
365	**练习 2**:TP 下会不会出现 rank 0 走图、rank 1 走 eager 的分裂状态?
366	
367	**答案**:不会。组比率 TP 不变(分子分母同除 \( W \)),谓词输入在每个 rank 上相同,输出必然一致;`tp_executor.rs` 的注释与 `batch_decode.rs` 的运行期注释都把这列为设计不变量。
368	
369	**练习 3**:把 `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES` 从 `[1,2,3,4,6,8]` 扩到含 5,需要动本 crate 的哪些代码?
370	
371	**答案**:一处都不用动——清单属于 `pegainfer-kernels` 的 attention 模块(内核编译侧),经 `pegainfer_kernels::ops` → `pegainfer_core::ops` 两级重导出后,本 crate 在 `decode_group_is_compiled` 里以全路径 `pegainfer_core::ops::SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES` 引用(`model.rs` 顶部的 `pub(crate) use` 重导出的是 GDN head dim 常量,不是这份清单)。内核侧多编译一个组比率,配置层的谓词自动放行。这体现了"算子面由 kernels 拥有、模型 crate 只消费"的边界。
372	
373	## 5. 综合实践
374	
375	把本讲三个模块串成一次完整的"TP 几何审计"。任务:为一个**新规格的 Qwen3.5 检查点**写启动前评审意见。

382	  "num_key_value_heads": 8,
383	  "intermediate_size": 13824,

385	  "linear_num_value_heads": 32,

392	请完成三步并写出结论:
393	
394	1. **模型级**(u2-l1 知识):`Config35` 的头整除不变量是否满足?(40 % 8 = 5 ✓;32 % 8 = 4 ✓)
395	2. **TP 几何级**(本讲 4.2):分别对 \( W = 2 \) 和 \( W = 4 \) 推导全部 `local_*` 字段;判断哪个 \( W \) 能通过四条整除门。参考答案:两个 \( W \) 均可(40/2=20、8/2=4、13824/2=6912、8/2=4;40/4=10、8/4=2、13824/4=3456、8/4=2);\( W=4 \) 时 local kv 头只剩 2,`local_full_attn_kv_dim = 512`。

397	
398	检验方式:把你的推导与 `src/config/tp.rs` 内嵌测试(尤其 [L272-L285](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L272-L285) 与 [L302-L359](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L302-L359))的断言风格对齐;若本地有完整 qwen35 工具链,可仿照测试夹具把上述字段填进 JSON、跑 `cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --lib config::tp` 验证(**待本地验证**)。

400	## 6. 本讲小结
401	
402	- **类型化校验**:`TensorParallelConfig` 用私有字段 + `TryFrom` 构造边界让 `world_size == 0`、`rank >= world_size` 不可表示;`Default` 即 TP1,所以"单 GPU"只是 \( W = 1 \) 的特例而非独立路径。

# 讲义 u2-l2:张量并行几何:TensorParallelConfig 与 LocalGeometry

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲(u2-l1)我们看到 `Config35` 是一个**对张量并行一无所知**的类型——它只描述"这个模型长什么样",不描述"这张卡分到哪一块"。本讲补上另一半:当多张 GPU 一起服务同一个 Qwen3.5 模型时,每个 rank 如何得到自己那份合法的维度。

学完本讲,你应该能够:

1. 解释「不可表示非法状态」(make invalid states unrepresentable)这种构造期校验风格在 `src/config/tp.rs` 中的落地方式:为什么 `TensorParallelConfig` 的字段是私有的、为什么非法的 `(rank, world_size)` 根本构造不出来。
2. 亲手推导 TP 切分公式:给定全局的 `num_attention_heads`、`num_key_value_heads`、`intermediate_size`、`linear_num_key_heads` 等字段和 `world_size`,算出 `LocalGeometry` 的全部 `local_*` 字段。
3. 说出哪四个字段的整除性失败会触发 `ConfigError::TpIndivisible`,以及为什么 `linear_num_value_heads` 不需要单独检查。
4. 说明「P2c 门」是什么:CUDA Graph 与编译 GQA 组合的兼容性在哪一层校验、为什么它在执行器启动层而不是 `tp.rs` 里、以及未编译组走哪条回退路径。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 张量并行(Tensor Parallelism,TP)是什么

一个 Transformer 的权重是大矩阵。单卡放不下、或想加快前向时,可以把矩阵切开分给多张卡,每张卡算自己那一块,再用集合通信(all-reduce / all-gather)把结果拼回来。这就是 Megatron-LM 风格的张量并行:

- **行切分(row shard)**:把权重矩阵的输出维度切开,每卡持有连续的若干行。本讲后面看到的 `q_proj`、`in_proj` 等输出维度的切分就是行切分。
- **列切分(column shard)**:把输入维度切开。例如 `o_proj` 的输入是注意力头拼接后的维度,头被切走了,输入列也要跟着切。

TP 有几个关键名词:

- **rank**:本进程在 TP 组里的编号,从 0 开始。
- **world_size**:TP 组的卡数,记作 \( W \)。
- **shard(分片)**:某个全局维度中本 rank 持有的 `(offset, len)` 切片。

### 2.2 GQA 与「组比率」

Qwen3.5 的全注意力层用分组查询注意力(GQA):`num_key_value_heads` 个 KV 头服务 `num_attention_heads` 个 Q 头,平均每个 KV 头带

\[ g = \frac{\text{num\_attention\_heads}}{\text{num\_key\_value\_heads}} \]

个 Q 头,称为 **GQA 组比率**。批量解码内核是按组比率编译的——只有一部分组比率有现成内核(本讲 4.3 会看到具体清单)。记住一个本讲最重要的观察:**头切分不改变组比率**,因为分子分母被同一个 \( W \) 除。

### 2.3 「不可表示非法状态」

这是贯穿 PegaInfer 配置层的校验哲学(上一讲已见):与其在调用点到处 `if world_size == 0 { return Err }`,不如让**类型本身无法装下非法值**——字段私有、只能通过一个做完全部检查的构造函数获得实例。于是下游代码拿到值就一定是合法的,校验逻辑只存在一份。本讲的 `TensorParallelConfig` 是这个风格最纯粹的示范。

### 2.4 混合架构提醒

Qwen3.5 每层要么是 full attention(走分页 KV),要么是 linear attention(Gated DeltaNet,走固定大小递推状态)。TP 切分对两种层都要成立:全注意力层切 Q/KV 头,线性注意力层切 key/value 头——这就是为什么 `LocalGeometry` 里同时有 `local_full_attn_*` 和 `local_linear_*` 两族字段。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| [src/config/tp.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs) | `TensorParallelConfig` 与 `LocalGeometry` 的定义、校验与派生 | 本讲主角,全文精读 |

| [src/config/mod.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/mod.rs) | config 子模块的所有权模型声明 | 说明 `model` 与 `tp` 的方向性边界 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

本讲按规格拆成三个最小模块:**类型化校验**(4.1)、**shard 切分公式**(4.2)、**kernel 兼容门**(4.3)。

### 4.1 类型化校验:让非法 (rank, world_size) 不可构造

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`TensorParallelConfig` 回答一个极小的问题:"本进程是 TP 组里的几号、组里一共几张卡?" 只有 `rank` 和 `world_size` 两个字段。

它的设计要点在于:这两个字段**是私有的**。外部没有任何办法直接 `TensorParallelConfig { rank: 7, world_size: 2 }` 这样拼出一个荒谬的指派(rank 7 不存在于 2 卡组)。获得实例的途径只有两条:

1. `TryFrom<(usize, usize)>`——做完全部检查的构造边界;
2. `Default`——单卡(rank 0, world 1)。

于是 `world_size == 0`、`rank >= world_size` 这两类非法指派**在类型层面不可表示**,任何下游代码拿到 `TensorParallelConfig` 就不必再防御性地检查它们。对比一下反面做法:如果全代码库传的是裸 `(usize, usize)`,每个消费点都得自己判一次合法——漏一处就是运行期越界。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`TryFrom<(rank, world_size)>` 的校验是两步有序检查、首错即返:

```text
输入 (rank, world_size)
  ├─ world_size == 0 ?           → Err(TpZeroWorldSize)
  ├─ rank >= world_size ?        → Err(TpRankOutOfRange { rank, world_size })
  └─ 否则                        → Ok(TensorParallelConfig { rank, world_size })
```

构造成功后,这个类型对外只暴露四个只读方法:

| 方法 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `rank()` | 本进程编号 |
| `world_size()` | 组内卡数 \( W \) |
| `is_sharded()` | `world_size > 1`,即"真的在多卡切分吗" |
| `shard_range(total)` | 把全局行数 `total` 均分,返回本 rank 的 `(offset, len)` |

`shard_range` 的公式是朴素的整数除法:

\[ \text{shard\_len} = \left\lfloor \frac{\text{total}}{W} \right\rfloor, \qquad \text{offset} = \text{rank} \times \text{shard\_len} \]

注意这里**不做**余数处理——它只在已被证明整除的维度上被调用(4.2 会看到那道整除门)。这是"每条规则只在一处强制"的又一体现:整除性由 `LocalGeometry::try_new` 负责,`shard_range` 只管算术。

### 4.2 shard 切分公式:LocalGeometry 从已验证的 Config35 派生本 rank 维度

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

`LocalGeometry` 回答的问题是:"在 `W` 卡 TP 下,**本 rank** 的全注意力头数、KV 头数、MLP 中间宽度、线性注意力头数……各是多少?" 它是 `Qwen35Model` 加载一切缓冲、切一切权重所依据的几何底座。

它的输入是两个**已经各自合法**的类型:`&Config35`(模型几何,上一讲)和 `TensorParallelConfig`(TP 指派,本讲 4.1)。它的工作分两段:

1. **兼容性校验**:不是所有合法模型都能配所有 `world_size`——切不开就得拒。
2. **维度派生**:对切得开的模型,算出本 rank 的全部 `local_*` 字段。

方向性边界在模块文档里写得非常清楚:[src/config/tp.rs:L1-L11](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L1-L11) 说明本模块**依赖** `model`(读已验证的 `Config35` 来派生分片维度),而 `model` 对 TP 一无所知、**从不反向依赖**本模块;下游代码接受这里产出的 `LocalGeometry` 类型,而不是拿着裸 `(rank, world_size)` 自己重算分片。`src/config/mod.rs` 的模块文档([L1-L9](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/mod.rs#L1-L9))把这套所有权模型总结为三条边界。

一句话:**`Config35` 描述"模型是什么",`TensorParallelConfig` 描述"我是谁",`LocalGeometry` 描述"我分到什么"。**

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`LocalGeometry::try_new(config, tp)` 先做**四条有序整除检查**(首错即返,错误都是 `TpIndivisible`):

```text
num_attention_heads  % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "num_attention_heads", ... }
num_key_value_heads  % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "num_key_value_heads", ... }
intermediate_size    % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "intermediate_size", ... }
linear_num_key_heads % W != 0  → TpIndivisible { field: "linear_num_key_heads", ... }
```

为什么 `linear_num_value_heads` 不在清单里?靠数学传递:`Config35` 层已强制 value 头数是 key 头数的整数倍(value = key × k,见 4.2.3 引用的 `LinearHeadDivisibility` 检查),而这里又强制 key 头数是 \( W \) 的倍数(key = \( W \) × m),于是 value = \( W \) × m × k,必然被 \( W \) 整除。源码注释也点明了这一点:"the value-head count follows from the `Config35` key/value-head invariant"。

四条检查通过后,派生公式如下(记 \( W \) = world_size,`hd` = head_dim = 256,`khd` = linear_key_head_dim = 128,`vhd` = linear_value_head_dim = 128——三个 head dim 都是 AOT 内核烘焙的常量,上一讲已讲):

| 字段 | 公式 |
|---|---|
| `local_num_attention_heads` | \( \text{num\_attention\_heads} / W \) |
| `local_num_key_value_heads` | \( \text{num\_key\_value\_heads} / W \) |
| `local_intermediate_size` | \( \text{intermediate\_size} / W \) |
| `local_full_attn_q_dim` | \( \text{local\_num\_attention\_heads} \times \text{hd} \) |
| `local_full_attn_kv_dim` | \( \text{local\_num\_key\_value\_heads} \times \text{hd} \) |
| `local_full_attn_gated_q_dim` | \( 2 \times \text{local\_full\_attn\_q\_dim} \)(Q 与 gate 拼在一起) |
| `local_linear_num_key_heads` | \( \text{linear\_num\_key\_heads} / W \) |
| `local_linear_num_value_heads` | \( \text{linear\_num\_value\_heads} / W \) |
| `local_linear_q_dim`(内部量) | \( \text{local\_linear\_num\_key\_heads} \times \text{khd} \) |
| `local_linear_v_dim` | \( \text{local\_linear\_num\_value\_heads} \times \text{vhd} \) |
| `local_linear_qkv_dim` | \( 2 \times \text{local\_linear\_q\_dim} + \text{local\_linear\_v\_dim} \)(k 行镜像 q 行) |
| `local_linear_z_dim` | \( = \text{local\_linear\_v\_dim} \)(z 投影输出宽等于 v 维) |

注意一个容易忽略的事实:**`hidden_size` 从不切分**。残差流宽度在所有 rank 上完整保留,被切的只是各投影的输出维与 MLP 中间维。`local_full_attn_q_dim` 等字段也不是逐条独立检查的产物,而是派生——检查只针对"切得开"的头数/宽度,维度跟着头数走。

消费侧:`LocalGeometry` 是 `Clone + Copy` 的小结构,加载时存进 `Qwen35Model.geometry` 字段([src/weights.rs:L57-L87](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L57-L87)),权重切片结构 `Shard` / `WeightSource` 全部从它取范围——例如 [src/weights/layers.rs:L191-L211](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L191-L211) 的 `Shard::flat(global, geometry)` 就是 `shard_range` 的一层薄封装,把 `(offset, len)` 与切分前的全局宽度配对(防呆:range 与 global 必须成对出现,防止把 A 维度的范围配到 B 维度的全局值上)。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

结构体定义——[src/config/tp.rs:L71-L90](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L71-L90) 定义 `LocalGeometry`:它内嵌一个 `tp: TensorParallelConfig` 并携带十个 `local_*` 字段。文档注释强调它"从已验证的模型配置 + TP 指派 + cuda-graph 模式构造一次",下游用**这个类型**来定缓冲大小、算分片,**绝不**用裸的 rank/world-size 对。

派生公式本体——[src/config/tp.rs:L140-L166](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L140-L166):先算四个"头数/宽度"的 local 值,再组合出 q/kv/gated/qkv 维度,最后 `Ok(Self { .. })` 一次性构造。注意 `local_full_attn_gated_q_dim` 直接写为 `local_full_attn_q_dim * 2`、`local_linear_qkv_dim` 写为 `local_linear_q_dim * 2 + local_linear_v_dim`,注释说明"k 行镜像 q 行"——融合 qkv 投影里 q 与 k 两段行数相同。

TP1 契约与只读访问器——[src/config/tp.rs:L168-L229](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L168-L229):前半是一批转发到内嵌 `tp` 的方法(`rank` / `world_size` / `is_sharded` / `shard_range`),后半是各 `local_*` 的 getter。中间 [L209-L211](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L209-L211) 有一条"TP1 契约"注释:**world_size 为 1 时所有 local 维度等于全局维度**,所以单卡路径下一切内核/缓冲/递推状态保持 TP 之前的形状——这就是"单 GPU = TP 的 W=1 特例"在数据上的保证。

上游整除不变量(为什么 value 头数免检)——[src/config/model.rs:L254-L271](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L254-L271) 是 `Config35` 构造时的两条头整除检查:`linear_num_value_heads` 必须是 `linear_num_key_heads` 的倍数(`LinearHeadDivisibility`),`num_attention_heads` 必须是 `num_key_value_heads` 的倍数(`AttentionHeadDivisibility`)。`tp.rs` 的整除门建立在这两条之上。

生产调用点——[src/weights.rs:L141-L164](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L141-L164):`from_safetensors_with_runtime_and_capacity` 先 `Config35::from_file`,然后 `runtime.tensor_parallel.unwrap_or_default()`——**单 GPU 加载时没有 TP 指派,`None` 折叠成 `Default`(TP1)**,接着 `LocalGeometry::try_new(&config, tensor_parallel)` 完成"模型 × 指派"的兼容校验。一切发生在 mmap 权重、分配 CUDA 缓冲**之前**——一个切不开的组合在花费任何加载成本之前就被拒绝。TP 指派如何进入 `ModelRuntimeConfig` 见 [src/weights.rs:L36-L43](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L36-L43)(字段 `tensor_parallel: Option<TensorParallelConfig>`)。

`shard_range` 的三段偏移消费——[src/weights/layers.rs:L393-L406](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights/layers.rs#L393-L406):融合线性注意力 qkv 投影的切分不是简单一段,而是对 q、k、v **三个全局段**分别取 `shard_range`,再叠上段基址偏移(`global_q + k_rel`、`global_q + global_k + v_rel`)。这是 `shard_range` 最有代表性的消费方式:每段的 `shard_len` 相同(都除以同一个 \( W \)),但 offset 要加上段起点。

`is_sharded` 的一个实际用途——[src/weights.rs:L188](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/weights.rs#L188):`(geometry.world_size() == 1).then(|| WeightPrefetch::spawn(...))`——只有单卡才预取权重分片;TP 路径每个 rank 各自 mmap,不启用这个预取。

### 4.3 kernel 兼容门:P2c——CUDA Graph 与编译 GQA 组合

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

批量解码(full attention 部分)有一个按 **GQA 组比率**编译的内核族。它不是对所有组比率都有现成版本——[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/attention.rs:L21](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/attention.rs#L21) 列出支持清单:

```rust
pub const SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES: &[usize] = &[1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8];
```

CUDA Graph(第 4 单元会细讲)要求把整步解码内核**捕获**进图里重放。如果当前组比率没有编译版批量解码内核,就得改走"批量混合 eager 回退"路径——用 paged-prefill 内核按单 token 步进计划跑注意力。这条回退路径**不能被图捕获**。于是产生一个兼容性问题:

> 用户请求了 CUDA Graph + 当前 GQA 组没有编译内核,怎么办?

答案分两层,这就是源码注释里称为 **P2c** 的门(注释中的编号,指该兼容性条目):

1. **谓词层**(`Config35::decode_group_is_compiled`):组比率 ∈ `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES`?这是**配置层**的纯函数,不含 TP。
2. **决策层**(执行器启动):`enable_cuda_graph && decode_group_is_compiled()` 才启用图;否则**降级到 eager 路径并打日志**,而不是报错拒绝启动。

关键在于:这个门**不在 `tp.rs` 里**。`LocalGeometry::try_new` 的文档注释([src/config/tp.rs:L93-L108](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/tp.rs#L93-L108))明确写着:"CUDA Graph under TP is gated at executor startup on `Config35::decode_group_is_compiled` (P2c): uncompiled GQA groups keep the batched eager path instead of failing validation here."——几何校验管几何,内核路由门放在启动层,职责不混。

而这一切在 TP 下不产生"各 rank 裁决不一致"的风险,原因是 4.2 练习 1 的结论:**组比率 TP 不变**。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
启动(enable_cuda_graph, W 卡)
  ├─ 每个 rank: LocalGeometry::try_new 通过(几何已验证)
  ├─ 谓词: decode_group_is_compiled()
  │     = SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES.contains(num_attention_heads / num_key_value_heads)
  │     (组比率 TP 不变 ⇒ 所有 rank 得到同一答案)
  ├─ graph_enabled = enable_cuda_graph && compiled
  ├─ 未编译: 打一次 info 日志(Once 保证),decode 留在批量 eager 路径
  └─ 运行期 batch_decode:
        compiled  → 正常批量解码内核(可入图)
        未编译   → paged-prefill 内核 + 每 token 步进计划(eager),
                   且断言 graph_use == Serve(禁止把 eager 路径捕获进图)
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

谓词定义——[src/config/model.rs:L146-L152](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs#L146-L152):`decode_group_is_compiled` 一行核心——查 `num_attention_heads / num_key_value_heads` 是否在 `SUPPORTED_GQA_GROUP_SIZES` 里,注释说明"未编译的 GQA 组走批量混合 eager 回退"。注意它读的是**全局**配置字段,而组比率无论全局还是本 rank 都相同。

启动层的门——[src/tp_executor.rs:L714-L733](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/tp_executor.rs#L714-L733):加载完全部 rank 的模型后,取 rank 0 的模型算 `graph_enabled = enable_cuda_graph && first.config().decode_group_is_compiled()`。上方注释就是 P2c 条目的正文:"graph decode under TP requires a compiled batch-decode kernel for the rank-local GQA group. The group ratio is TP-invariant, so every rank decides identically; an uncompiled group keeps the batched eager path byte-for-byte."("byte-for-byte"意为回退路径的数值行为与无图时完全一致。)若请求了图但未启用,用 `std::sync::Once` 只打一次 info 日志,日志里用 `geometry.local_num_attention_heads() / geometry.local_num_key_value_heads()` 报出**本 rank 的**组比率与头数——注意这里正是 `LocalGeometry` 的 `local_*` 字段被消费的实例,且除法结果与全局组比率相同。

运行期的路由——[src/batch_decode.rs:L344-L360](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L344-L360):每步批量解码时再次按 `self.config.decode_group_is_compiled()` 分路——未编译就构造一个"eager decode"的每 token paged 计划,把全注意力交给 paged-prefill 内核。注释重申:"Head sharding leaves the q-per-kv group size unchanged, so the config-level predicate decides the per-rank route identically on every rank; the reroute adds no collectives."(头切分不改变组比率,配置层谓词让每个 rank 路由一致,改道不增加任何集合通信。)

eager 路径拒绝入图——[src/batch_decode.rs:L428-L443](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode.rs#L428-L443):`!decode_group_is_compiled()` 时 `anyhow::ensure!(graph_use == DecodeGraphUse::Serve, ...)`——批量混合 eager 回退只支持惰性的服务态解码,任何试图对它做图捕获/重放的 `graph_use` 都直接报错。这把"eager 路径不可入图"从约定升格为断言。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

    ))
